value.answer: There's no single 5-year fixed rate. It depends on the lender and on whether your mortgage is insured (under 20% down) or uninsured. As of Oct 12, the lowest insured 5-year fixed I can see is 4.34%, with Frank Mortgage offering it. The lowest uninsured is 4.44%. The big banks are higher, averaging about 5.14%, and rates are climbing this month.
